# James Robert Telfer (~1866–?)

**Role:** Eldest son of [[Robert Telfer (1835–1907)]] — station hand at Moorak
**Spouse:** Hannah Peacock (1840–1915)
**Father:** [[Robert Telfer (1835–1907)]]
**Mother:** Susan Burton (1844–1924)

## Life Summary

James Robert Telfer was the eldest son of Robert Telfer and Susan Burton. He worked as a station hand at Moorak Station and married Hannah Peacock. They had three children — Leslie Robert, Ethel Edith and Jean.

*(From the Borders to the Bush, p. 227)*

## Sources

- **Source:** Donald Telfer, *From the Borders to the Bush* (ISBN 0 7316 6387 X), p. 227, 230
